title: MONUMENT: GENERAL DOUGLAS MACARTHUR PARK, HISTORIC-CULTURAL MONUMENT
text:

  #100

  Plan Area: Westlake  Council District: 1 – Hernandez

  PROPERTY ADDRESS: 2351 Wilshire Boulevard; 2228 – 2320 West 6th Street;

  Commission review and comment on proposed perimeter fencing.

  Owner/Applicant:  City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks

summary: Commission review and comment on proposed perimeter fencing for General Douglas MacArthur Park Historic-Cultural Monument in Westlake.
